findings.evidence: Exact ID-only Map projection and owned rows preserve current learned order/duplicates and hint values; no name-based learned inference or purchase/discount computation. Existing hint-resolution/RNG tail is byte-identical.

The new GET handler receives no ApiState or engine. Server warms factory before accepting requests; the existing INITIALIZED mutex returns immediately after warmup. list_all clones display strings under the existing catalog lock. Wrong methods use the existing known-path refusal.

Panel rows derive from current props every render. Only local metadata state and same-origin catalog GET are introduced. Abort is checked after JSON completes and in failure handling. Actual React StrictMode late-JSON control preserved fresh/current rows and all frozen inputs.

React text children render catalog/ID content without HTML injection; full retained arrays are rendered and CSS scrolls instead of slicing. Independent runtime control did not retest the owner browser mobile/scroll suite.

Per-row Name not in catalog is also visible while the catalog is loading or unavailable; that local label alone cannot prove absence. The aggregate status explains the failed metadata request. Name unavailable would describe both states without altering behavior.

initial_fixture_failure.reason: Private virtual-HTTP page navigation timed out before component assertions. Product source was unchanged. A separately retained fixture revision uses direct private-page script/style injection; deferred metadata transport and all assertions are unchanged.
